title: Xounii Shifter / Tqiv Trusik Fanatic
summary: Recognize the roaming creature's disguises and reveal the Xounii Shifter.
overview: Recognize the roaming creature's disguises and reveal the Xounii Shifter.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Keep tracking the same enemy through its name and appearance changes.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The roaming fanatic changes between cragbeast, lifesipper and beetle appearances at set waypoints.
At 50% health it reveals the Tqiv Trusik Fanatic form.
At 15% it changes again to Xounii Shifter.
The reviewed script changes name and appearance but does not define additional timed attacks for those forms.

notes: Approval E412. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
